==Russian==

===Etymology===
Perhaps from {{af|ru|о-|пу́стошь|-и́ть}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|опустоши́ть}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|опустоши́ть|pf|impf=опустоша́ть}}

# to [[devastate]], to [[ravage]], to [[lay waste]]
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to [[empty]]
# {{lb|ru|figuratively|colloquial}} to [[guzzle]]
# to [[drain]] [[someone]]'s [[spirit]], to [[have]] [[a]] [[devastating]] [[effect]] ''(on)''

====Conjugation====
{{ru-conj|pf|4b+p|опустоши́ть}}
